headline: EPS nearly triples sequentially, surges year-over-year
summary_short: TCC Group Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of NT$0.29, up 190.0% q/q from NT$0.10 and up 403.9% y/y from NT$0.06.
summary_long: EPS of NT$0.29 rose 190.0% sequentially from NT$0.10 and 403.9% year-over-year from NT$0.06. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
